STEP 14. Check connector A-21X at the MFI relay for 
damage.
Q: Is the harness connector in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 15.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection (P.00E-2). Then go to Step 20.
STEP 15. Check connector C-58 at ECM <M/T> or 
connector C-55 at PCM <A/T> for damage.
Q: Is the connector in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 16.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection (P.00E-2). Then go to Step 20.
STEP 16. Check for harness damage between MFI relay 
connector A-21X terminal 1 and crankshaft position 
sensor connector B-20 terminal 3.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 17.
NO : Repair it. Then go to Step 20.
